entities_list.description: Any contracting party, including licensor, licensee, producer, distributor, nursery, grower, cooperative, or other named legal entity.
Individuals mentioned by name, including signatories, witnesses, officers, representatives, or technical experts.
Companies, institutions, cooperatives, associations, government agencies, or corporate groups.
Geographic references such as countries, states, cities, regions, production territories, orchards, farms, vineyards, or distribution zones.
Identifiers and titles of agreements, licenses, schedules, annexes, exhibits, amendments, and related legal documents.
Effective dates, execution dates, renewal dates, expiration dates, reporting deadlines, harvest periods, or shipment schedules.
Explicit terms of months, years, seasons, or fixed periods stated in the contract.
Monetary values, fees, royalties, minimum guarantees, penalties, rebates, percentages, or financial obligations.
Duties or responsibilities such as payments, planting requirements, reporting, marketing, quality control, or delivery commitments.
Exclusive rights, licenses, sublicenses, distribution rights, territorial rights, and permissions granted.
Goods, crops, cultivars, plant varieties, seedlings, rootstock, and proprietary fruit referenced in the contract.
Brand names, marks, or logos explicitly licensed or protected under the contract.
Patents, plant variety rights, plant breeder rights, copyrights, and any proprietary agricultural technology referenced.
References to product quality, grading, certifications, phytosanitary standards, or compliance obligations.
Minimum planting or harvesting obligations, production thresholds, or supply commitments.
Entities in the agricultural supply chain such as logistics providers, cold storage facilities, exporters, and packhouses.
Events or conditions triggering termination, breach, or default (e.g., failure to pay, non-compliance, force majeure).
Arbitration rules, governing law, litigation venues, or conflict resolution mechanisms.
Addresses, emails, phone numbers, and designated contact persons for notices or communication.
References to technical training, cultivation advice, R&D support, or agricultural consultancy provided.
Obligations to provide records, accounting statements, production reports, or audits.
Regulatory or contractual compliance obligations (environmental, export laws, phytosanitary, labor).
Events like drought, flood, pests, natural disaster, disease, strikes, or war that impact obligations.
Defined regions or markets covered by the agreement (e.g., Production Territory, Exclusive Territory, Distribution Area).
